channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bismack Biyombo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bismack Biyombo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
Said Wembanyama:

“Bismack, I’ve talked to him about [the DRC]. I’ve asked him about what it’s like to go back to the country as an NBA player. … It’s great to have him here. And one last reason is that it is great to speak French to somebody.”

Victor Wembanyama on Bismack Biyombo, Jun 5, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Cason Wallace on Gordon Hayward, Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Cason Wallace on Gordon Hayward and Bismack Biyombo:

“It's interesting. They're good. They play their roles very well. I feel like they'll fit in with us.”

Cason Wallace on Gordon Hayward, Bismack Biyombo, Feb 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward, Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward's and Bismack Biyombo's usage:

“We're gonna try to make it as smooth and seamless as possible, which probably is not gonna look like a ton right away... Put them in a role where they can thrive early and see what happens from there.”

Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward, Bismack Biyombo, Feb 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Lucas Nogueira on Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
“I changed a lot of bad habits during the summer because I knew my chance was gonna come, because the cap, it was gonna be hard to keep (Bismack Biyombo),”

Lucas Nogueira on Bismack Biyombo, Nov 13, 2016. Source: Toronto Sun.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Lowry on life after Biyombo:

“Sometimes you get beat & just say 'Biz is there'. Biz is not there now so our reaction time has to be quicker”

Kyle Lowry on Bismack Biyombo, Sep 29, 2016. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Rob Hennigan on Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
“Bismack (Biyombo) is a tremendous competitor and athlete who excels on the defensive end of the floor. He proved during the playoffs that he can rebound and protect the rim at an elite level, and he will bring toughness and winning fiber to our frontcourt. We are confident that his best basketball is ahead of him and we’re extremely excited to welcome him to the Orlando Magic family,”

Rob Hennigan on Bismack Biyombo, Jul 7, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Tyronn Lue on Bismack Biyombo:

“They were winning, they were kicking our butts so he has the right to wave his finger”

Tyronn Lue on Bismack Biyombo, May 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Dwane Casey on DeMar DeRozan, Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Dwane Casey on using DeMar DeRozan over Bismack Biyombo in OT:

“That's the decision we made and went with it. It didn't work out”

Dwane Casey on DeMar DeRozan, Bismack Biyombo, May 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Dwane Casey on Bismack Biyombo:

“Some of the fight we have, it starts with him. He's the spirit of our team, he's kind of the soul of our team.”

Dwane Casey on Bismack Biyombo, Apr 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.
